rate_limits: Try environment: 10 requests per second per merchant. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429; Worldpay says to wait up to five minutes and remain below the limit. No Live-environment limit is stated.
description: Access Worldpay offers RESTful HTTPS APIs for card payments, tokenization, 3DS, payouts, and related commerce flows. Its enterprise Card Payments APIs use HTTP Basic authentication with credentials supplied by a Worldpay Implementation Manager. Merchants test on try.access.worldpay.com and use access.worldpay.com for live traffic.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Corrected—Try is capped at 10 requests/s per merchant; excess returns 429 and may require waiting up to 5 minutes; no Live cap is stated: https://docs.worldpay.com/access/products/get-started. example: Corrected to the documented v6 headers, payload fields, and authorized response shape: https://docs.worldpay.com/access/products/card-payments/v6/authorize-a-payment. description: Corrected—enterprise Access credentials come from an Implementation Manager, not generally a dashboard: https://docs.worldpay.com/access/products/card-payments/v6/get-started
